situation: Start at the board address #/ with the default data and let the clock run 2200 ms, so that every column has loaded.
Put focus on card SL-111 and press x. Then press Shift+X (capital X). Then press Shift+X again.
question: How many cards are selected at the end?
answer: None. The first Shift+X selected the rest of Ready (7 selected); the second Shift+X, with every card of Ready selected, cleared them all. The selection bar is gone.
